title: A failed upload, replacing a file, long names and a missing file
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A file to upload; an existing attachment to replace; a very long file name; and a field whose stored file can be removed from storage.
custom_steps:
1. Start uploading a file, then turn off the network (or set the browser offline) before it finishes so the upload fails partway; check no attachment is recorded and the author is told why.
2. Replace a file and confirm the new attachment is recorded and the old file is not removed.
3. Attach a file with a very long name and confirm the name is shortened in the interface rather than breaking the layout.
4. With the stored file missing while the field still refers to it, open it and confirm a message rather than a broken download.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If an upload fails partway, no attachment is recorded and the author is told why.
  • Replacing a file records the new attachment, and the old file is not removed.
  • An unusually long file name is shortened in the interface rather than breaking the layout.
  • If the stored file is missing while the field still refers to it, opening it fails with a message rather than a broken download.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9109 (S11 — Attach a reference file to a question); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S11; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E1: “If an upload fails partway, no attachment is recorded and the author is told why. A recorded attachment that points at nothing is the outcome to avoid”
  • S11-E2: “Replacing a file records the new attachment. The old file is not removed”
  • S11-E3: “An unusually long file name is shortened in the interface rather than breaking the layout”
  • S11-E4: “If the stored file is missing while the field still refers to it, opening it fails with a message rather than a broken download”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
